label: MC-002
note: Real concurrency defect: Task.WhenAll runs two queries concurrently on the SAME DbContext instance (not thread-safe) — corruption/crash. This is exactly the bug DR-007 warns against; the reviewer SHOULD flag it.

known_true_positive.title: Task.WhenAll runs two queries concurrently on the same DbContext
known_true_positive.why_it_matters: Both ToListAsync calls start before either is awaited, so two operations run on one DbContext, which is not thread-safe. EF Core throws 'A second operation was started on this context' or corrupts the change tracker.
